bounds: One reviewed send operation, two recipients, app-owned outbox indices0/1, role changes and ordered platform attempts. Preparation failure and partial dispatch are distinct terminal states.
limitations: The model covers the changed outgoing-history preparation/role/rollback boundary only. The older pin retains its unchanged outer bridge; this is not the newer canonical NativeSmsReviewOwnership model or a claim that all Shaw phone work is integrated.

Android implementation conformance uses the canonical five outgoing-history regressions plus eight existing journal/core tests under Robolectric29. Fake provider/radio ports do not prove physical carrier delivery, default-role provisioning or agent cellular audio.

Fair progress assumes provider preparation settles and the dispatch loop returns or throws. No successful delivery is assumed. Process crashes and arbitrary cross-process mutation are outside this bounded model.

assumptions: Weak fairness of preparation and dispatch settlement, including refusals.
